title: fix: honour aspectRatio on fal video fallbacks
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Fixed aspectRatio handling on the fal fallback routes for x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5, alibaba/wan-2.6, alibaba/wan-2.2-fast, and bytedance/seedance-1-pro-fast. When width and height are omitted, a supported aspectRatio now takes precedence over the 1024×1024 default; unsupported ratios and explicit dimensions still select the closest supported ratio. These routes handle requests when a primary fails with a 5xx, 401–429, or network error. A focused test covers all four routes and both precedence cases; a local fallback check returned an 864×480 video for aspectRatio=16:9. The model contract is unchanged.
